us_counterpart: Communications Decency Act Section 230 (47 U.S.C. 230)
us_citation: Pub. L. 104-104, title V, sec. 509, 110 Stat. 56 (Telecommunications Act of 1996); 47 U.S.C. 230
rationale: Section 230 sets the intermediary-liability regime for online platforms, like the DSA's liability safe harbours, but it grants immunity and imposes none of the DSA's due-diligence, transparency or risk-assessment duties.
